stories.title: Northern Sea Route freight traffic up 13% in five months
stories.summary: Deputy Minister for the Development of the Russian Far East and Arctic Anton Basansky said that transit freight traffic had also increased
article_sentences: Freight traffic along the Northern Sea Route increased by 13% in the first five months of 2026, State Secretary and Deputy Minister for the Development of the Russian Far East and Arctic Anton Basansky said.
"Over the past five months of this year, freight traffic reached 12.9 million metric tons, which is 13% higher than in previous years," he said at the Eastern Economic Forum.
He noted that transit freight traffic had also increased.
The Eastern Economic Forum is being held on September 1-4 in Vladivostok on the campus of Far Eastern Federal University.
The forum is organized by the Roscongress Foundation with the support of the Russian government.
TASS is the general information partner.

stories.title: Russian carmaker Moskvich plans to produce over 20,000 cars in 2026
stories.summary: Moskvich CEO Elena Frolova noted that the automaker is also steadily increasing production volumes
article_sentences: Russian carmaker Moskvich plans to produce more than 20,000 vehicles in 2026, including 5,000-6,000 vehicles from its new M lineup, the M70 and M90, Moskvich CEO Elena Frolova told TASS on the sidelines of the Eastern Economic Forum.
"We are aiming to surpass 20,000," she said when asked about the company's production target for this year.
"We will most likely manage to produce around 5,000-6,000 M70 and M90 vehicles in total," the head of the automaker added.
At the same time, Moskvich vehicle sales may reach 1,200-1,500 units in September 2026, Frolova said.
But we expect that we may reach 1,200-1,500 in September," she said.
According to Frolova, the automaker is also steadily increasing production volumes.
The Eastern Economic Forum is being held on September 1-4 in Vladivostok on the campus of Far Eastern Federal University.
The forum is organized by the Roscongress Foundation with the support of the Russian government.
TASS is the general information partner.
